Epoch reset race can skip events if processes are not stopped first.
Over-suppression if signatures are too coarse.
baseline: Always execute wave>worker on each repeated morph change.
measured_gain: Verified reduction in repeated compute for the stable admin-update residual; no claim yet of improved residual closure.
rollback: Disable learned influence or restore prior watcher; event logs and archived epochs retained.
